# yxml

The XML tokenizer is Yoran Heling’s yxml. The source files derive from FreeBSD pkg tag `2.0.0`. Their original MIT license is kept in `LICENSE` and is bundled in the Android APK at `android/app/src/main/assets/licenses/yxml.txt`. [Upstream](https://dev.yorhel.nl/yxml) · [Vendored source](https://github.com/freebsd/pkg/tree/2.0.0/external/yxml)

Comments and license headers have been removed from `yxml.c` and `yxml.h`. The code tokens retain their original order and values. A token comparison against Git records the verification result.
